hypothesis: A DV claimant cannot tell whether the carrier's offer is fair because they have no independent figure. An article that hands them the NAIC 10-20% band, the Georgia-only-17c fact, and the "show me your calculation" sentence resolves that, and converts only the people who then want the full toolkit.
target_buyer: US consumer whose car was repaired after a not-at-fault accident

actions.grounding: NAIC Journal of Insurance Regulation 2023 (content.naic.org) - 10-20% band, 17c Georgia-only, mileage double-counting

baseline.note: gross views include our own verification fetch
baseline.unique_visitors: UNKNOWN - Telegraph exposes only a cumulative counter
baseline.outbound_clicks: UNKNOWN - UTM set, no click backend

success_criterion: >=1 completed order OR >=1 qualified buyer inquiry within window
